acceptance: The VM has a host-task execution path for capability-aware native functions declared async; calling one returns a Task and the actual host operation runs only when the scheduler drives that task, preserving await and cancellation semantics.

The stdlib exposes fs.read_text(path) as async Task[String] and fs.roots() as List[String]; read_text requires filesystem.read and roots requires filesystem.roots, with no implicit grant from provider installation or CLI startup.

A per-VM FilesystemSource owns the host filesystem policy and root set; a deterministic map provider supports tests/embedders, values are copied at the boundary, and no process-global filesystem service is introduced.

A missing file is a recoverable Failure from the provider, while missing provider or capability is the stable AIPO_RT_CAPABILITY_DENIED fault; invalid path/provider contract errors are typed and never panic.
Native metadata and AHS/tooling data expose asyncness and the exact capability for each fs operation; NativeRegistry remains a catalog, not an authorization boundary.
Tests cover async call/await, roots, missing file Failure, denied read/roots, provider isolation, root policy, cancellation/forgotten-task behavior where applicable, and capability declarations.

The slice documents async-first filesystem semantics, target limitations and resource/path policy; no write, symlink escape, network, process, crypto or unbounded read surface is added, and repository gates remain green.
